Go Further

The Adventure of Living with Jesus is the beginning of this journey. It guided your initial steps. The series below help with deeper heart transformation as you continue for a longer stretch. These series explore different dimensions of your new life in Christ—your heart, your identity, the greatness of God, the Spirit’s presence, and the habits of growing mature in Christ.

You do not have to use them in order. Begin with the series that meets the need of your current discipleship situation. Each series can be downloaded free from the Leaders Kit: equip.jesusonline.com/leader-kits

A Heart After God · 9 lessons

Seven Reflections on the Inner Life

Learn to want what God wants—in the hidden places no one else sees.

Your New Identity in Christ · 10 lessons

Embracing Who God Says You Are

Settle the question of who you are now, so the old names lose their hold.

Beholding the Majesty of God · 6 lessons

Explore His Divine Attributes

Lift your eyes from your own story long enough to see the God who holds it.

Walking in the Spirit · 15 lessons

A Practical Guide to the Holy Spirit’s Presence, Power, and Fruit

Discover how the Spirit who lives in you shapes ordinary decisions, not only high moments.

Building Blocks for Maturity · 11 lessons

Practiced Steps of Growing Up in Christ

Grow up in Christ one practiced step at a time—not by trying harder, but by walking with Him.

We Would Be Grateful to Hear from You

If you have led a Moment from this kit—or walked someone through the chapter that follows—please tell us. A few sentences about where you serve and what God is forming in those you lead will encourage the next leader and help us serve you better.

equip.jesusonline.com/reviews/share

MAIN KEY TAKE-AWAY

He is already with you. Choose one series and take the next step.
